{{Top}}
The '''Mandalorian chamber''' was a customization for certain [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] weapons that broadened the energy beam, resulting in an increase in damage. The Mark I, II, & III [[Firing chamber|chambers]] in turn allowed for considerable boosts in the potential for injury from the [[Plasma/Legends|plasma]] energy, as well as a degree of disorientation in the target.
